Selected Work

Selected work in UX research, mixed-methods inquiry, trust and perception research, and behavior in context.

Experience research · Inclusion

When Workplace Initiatives Feel Inclusive

Research examining how representation changes whether workplace initiatives feel relevant, supportive, and inclusive to different groups.

Trust · Perception research

How People Interpret Organizational Commitments

Survey and experimental research on how people distinguish symbolic from substantive action and how credibility shifts when commitments change.

Conversation design · Behavior

How Context Shapes User Response

Study of online conversation environments showing that the same experience can lead to different outcomes depending on audience and context.

Longitudinal research · Daily experience

Tracking Daily Experience Over Time

Experience-sampling project illustrating how repeated-measures data can reveal shifting patterns in attention, context, and response.
